results.snippet: # What Is the US Dollar Index (DXY)? what is us dollar index. The US Dollar Index (DXY) measures the value of the US dollar against a basket of six major currencies, led by the euro. It rises when the dollar strengthens and falls when it weakens, making it a key gauge of dollar strength for forex, commodity and gold traders. The US Dollar Index (DXY) measures the aggregate strength of the US currency against six major global currencies using a geometric weighted mean. The index uses a geometric weighted mean of six bilateral exchange rates, with the Euro maintaining a dominant 57.6% share.
